title: 教玩具行业与产品全景

intro.background: 教玩具行业是一个和文具完全不同的赛道。它不是卖标准SKU，而是卖项目、卖方案、卖整园设计。浙江温州永嘉桥下镇被称为中国教玩具之都。
intro.desc: 认识教玩具三大产品线，掌握行业核心术语。
tasks: 区分班级家具、功能教室、户外设备
outcomes: 能用英语介绍公司产品线
能区分项目制和标准品外贸

oneLiner.en: Teaching toys are not products on a shelf - they are whole-playground projects.
oneLiner.cn: 教玩具不是货架上的产品——它是从设计到整个幼儿园落地的项目。

vocab.ex: We supply a full range of teaching toys.
vocab.exCn: 我们供应全系列教玩具。

vocab.ex: Outdoor playground equipment includes slides and climbing frames.
vocab.exCn: 户外游乐设备包括滑梯和攀爬架。

vocab.ex: Solid wood kindergarten furniture is our core line.
vocab.exCn: 实木幼儿园家具是核心产品线。
我们提供整园交钥匙项目。

vocab.ex: We provide both OEM and ODM services.
Our factory is in Qiaoxia, the teaching toy capital.
vocab.exCn: 我们工厂在桥下教玩具之都。

mistakes.right: We specialize in kindergarten furniture and playground equipment.
mistakes.cn: 错误：把自己说成普通玩具/文具贸易商。

basic.en: We are a manufacturer of kindergarten furniture.
basic.cn: 我们是幼儿园家具生产厂家。

basic.en: Our factory is in Qiaoxia, Wenzhou.
We have three main product lines.
Could you tell me the project size?
basic.cn: 您能告诉我项目规模吗？

advanced.en: Unlike stationery suppliers, we specialize in turnkey kindergarten projects from design to installation.
advanced.cn: 和文具供应商不同，我们专注整园交钥匙项目从设计到安装。
advanced.from: We are a manufacturer of kindergarten furniture.

lines.cn: 我们是桥下厂家，专注幼儿园家具和游乐设备。您能分享场地面积和预算吗？

scenario.q: A client asks what your company does. Reply.
scenario.modelAnswer: We are a manufacturer based in Qiaoxia, Wenzhou, specializing in kindergarten furniture, functional learning rooms, and outdoor playground equipment. We have completed turnkey projects in over 50 countries.
scenario.cn: 我们是温州桥下厂家，专注幼儿园家具、功能教室和户外游乐设备，50多国整园项目经验。

culture.title: B2B项目制思维转变
culture.content: 从教文具标准品转到教玩具项目制，最大转变是：客户买的不是产品，而是方案。先问需求再发产品，项目周期2-4个月，客单价10-50万美金。

rounds.ai: Hi, can you briefly introduce what you do?
rounds.cn: 能简单介绍一下你们做什么吗？
rounds.hint: 介绍桥下、三大产品线、整园项目。

rounds.ai: What information do you need from us?
